document_review.date_evidence: The official filename supplies 2026-8-15. The PDF metadata records creation and modification on 2026-08-20, consistent with a later file export; no competing event date is printed in the reviewed text.
document_review.author_and_issuer: Mayor Tim Keller / City of Albuquerque Mayor's Office
document_review.form: State of the City address and administration policy framework, not an adopted ordinance, resolution, implementation plan, City Council action, survey, or performance report.
document_review.scope: Explains the address's scarcity-to-abundance framing and discusses administration priorities including public safety, government-service friction, housing, City land and facilities, childcare, family recreation, addiction response, and intergovernmental coordination.
document_review.visual_and_text_review: The PDF has 15 numbered, text-led pages with repeated running title and third-term theory-of-change header. It is not a form, wrapper, fragment, or XFA placeholder; no embedded links were reported by extraction. Poppler was unavailable in this environment, so the visual finding is limited to page structure and PDF inspection rather than rendered-page screenshots.

The Albuquerque Progress Reports are indicator and scorecard records. This address refers broadly to community conditions but does not reproduce, replace, or update those reports.
